name: shabash-skill-check
description: Security scanner for Claude Code and Codex skills, plugins, hooks and MCP servers: finds hidden HTML instructions, invisible characters, commands that run by themselves, data sent out with curl, .env and keys read, prompt injection and unpinned npx packages. Reads only; nothing goes to Shabash.
